During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] conducted a '''massacre at Malthee''', a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], when the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] refused to open their world. [[Malthee]] was completely devastated by the Imperial bombardment, which reduced the city to a [[Malthee Crater|crater]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen's]] close ties to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], added to its [[Politics/Legends|political]] isolation from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], pressured it to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Kinyen surrendered without resistance to the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], on the condition that the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] did not occupy the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SoR" />

Three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]], the Empire used Kinyen as an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] staging area for its [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] [[Western Reaches Operation|campaign]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Empire forced the [[Gran/Legends|Gran's]] conditional surrender by deploying [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] in Kinyen's offworld quarters. As a reward for its peaceful surrender, Kinyen was allowed to continue engaging in [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] for more than a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]].<ref name="SoR" />

==The massacre==
Eventually, the Empire demanded a greater access to the planet and an increase of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] production, but the Gran refused. In response, a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] bombarded the heavily populated [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Malthee]], leaving nothing but a [[Malthee Crater|crater]].<ref name="SoR" /><ref name="GG12" />

Following the bombardment, the Empire broke the conditions of Kinyen's initial surrender and landed occupation forces. Early protests were put down violently, and the Gran were forced to capitulate utterly to the Empire.<ref name="SoR" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Malthee.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Malthee Crater]]]]
After the massacre, most Gran adopted a policy of peaceful patience, assuming the Empire would eventually implode. However, just as many Gran became sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The leader of the underground resistance, [[Gorbek Fask]], set up a network of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] that provided foodstuffs and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the Rebellion. Fearing more bombardments, the Gran restricted the Alliance from conducting military operations on Kinyen.<ref name="SoR" />

Additionally, the Malthee Crater became a monument to Imperial aggression and a site of pilgrimage. The Gran built a [[Granite/Legends|granite]] memorial around the crater, displaying the carved names of those lost in the tragedy. Later, a [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] [[Malthee Temple|temple]] was also erected at the Malthee Crater to provide services for those visiting to honor the lost.<ref name="SoR" />
